records.predicted_sql: SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE (COALESCE("Enrollment (K-12)", 0) + COALESCE("Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0)) > 500 LIMIT 10000
SELECT s.School, sat.NumTstTakr FROM satscores AS sat JOIN schools AS s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Contra Costa' ORDER BY sat.NumTstTakr DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds WHERE s.County = 'Riverside' GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.School, s.FundingType HAVING AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 400 LIMIT 10000

SELECT s.AvgScrMath, sc.County FROM satscores AS s JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode WHERE (s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrWrite) = (SELECT MIN(AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite) FROM satscores WHERE NOT AvgScrMath IS NULL AND NOT AvgScrRead IS NULL AND NOT AvgScrWrite IS NULL) LIMIT 10000

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE frpm."County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND schools.Charter = 0 AND (frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / NULLIF(frpm."Enrollment (K-12)", 0)) < 0.18 LIMIT 10000

SELECT c.id FROM cards AS c WHERE c.artist = 'Erica Yang' AND c.availability = 'paper' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM legalities AS l WHERE l.uuid = c.uuid AND l.format = 'pauper' AND l.status = 'legal') LIMIT 1
SELECT number FROM cards WHERE side IS NULL AND subtypes LIKE '%Angel%' AND subtypes LIKE '%Wizard%' LIMIT 10000
SELECT code, name FROM sets WHERE (mtgoCode IS NULL OR mtgoCode = '') ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT s.name FROM sets AS s WHERE s.code IN (SELECT DISTINCT st.setCode FROM set_translations AS st WHERE st.language = 'Russian') ORDER BY s.baseSetSize DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM cards WHERE borderColor = 'black' LIMIT 10000
SELECT name FROM cards WHERE frameVersion = '2003' ORDER BY convertedManaCost DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT c.name, r.text FROM cards AS c JOIN rulings AS r ON c.uuid = r.uuid JOIN sets AS s ON c.setCode = s.code JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap' AND fd.language = 'Italian' LIMIT 10000
SELECT st.translation FROM cards AS c JOIN sets AS s ON c.setCode = s.code JOIN set_translations AS st ON s.code = st.setCode WHERE c.name = 'Fellwar Stone' AND st.language = 'Japanese' LIMIT 1

WITH yearly_counts AS (SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', releaseDate) AS year, COUNT(*) AS set_count FROM sets WHERE releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31' GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y', releaseDate)), language_counts AS (SELECT language, COUNT(*) AS lang_count FROM foreign_data GROUP BY language) SELECT ROUND(AVG(set_count), 2) AS annual_average_sets, (SELECT language FROM language_counts ORDER BY lang_count DESC LIMIT 1) AS common_language FROM yearly_counts LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS badge_count FROM badges WHERE UserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie') LIMIT 10000
SELECT CommentCount FROM posts WHERE ViewCount = 1910 LIMIT 10000
SELECT ViewCount FROM posts WHERE Title = 'Integration of Weka and/or RapidMiner into Informatica PowerCenter/Developer' LIMIT 10000
SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE WebsiteUrl = 'http://stackoverflow.com' LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'Daniel Vassallo') LIMIT 10000
SELECT Title FROM posts ORDER BY ViewCount DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT p.Title FROM posts AS p INNER JOIN postLinks AS pl ON p.Id = pl.PostId ORDER BY pl.CreationDate ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Citizen Patrol' LIMIT 10000

WITH most_influential AS (SELECT OwnerUserId FROM posts WHERE NOT OwnerUserId IS NULL GROUP BY OwnerUserId ORDER BY MAX((SELECT Reputation FROM users WHERE users.Id = posts.OwnerUserId)) DESC LIMIT 1), user_posts AS (SELECT Id, Score FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT OwnerUserId FROM most_influential)) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage FROM user_posts LIMIT 10000
SELECT c.Text FROM comments AS c JOIN posts AS p ON c.PostId = p.Id WHERE p.ViewCount BETWEEN 100 AND 150 ORDER BY c.Score DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT u.UpVotes FROM users AS u WHERE u.Id = (SELECT UserId FROM comments WHERE Text = 'R is also lazy evaluated.') LIMIT 10000
SELECT AVG(t.Price) FROM transactions_1k AS t JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE g.Country = 'CZE' LIMIT 10000

SELECT ym.Date, ym.Consumption FROM yearmonth AS ym WHERE ym.CustomerID = (SELECT DISTINCT t.CustomerID FROM transactions_1k AS t WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Amount = 124.05) AND ym.Date LIKE '2012-01%' LIMIT 10000
SELECT gs.Country FROM gasstations AS gs JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON gs.GasStationID = t.GasStationID WHERE t.ProductID = 2 ORDER BY t.Price DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.player_name FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.height > 180 GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name HAVING COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) > 0 ORDER BY AVG(pa.heading_accuracy) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.ball_control ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.id ELSE NULL END)) - (SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.ball_control ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.id ELSE NULL END)) AS ball_control_difference FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id LIMIT 10000
SELECT l.name FROM League AS l WHERE l.id = (SELECT league_id FROM Match WHERE season = '2008/2009' GROUP BY league_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 10000
SELECT defenceAggressionClass FROM Team_Attributes WHERE team_api_id = (SELECT team_api_id FROM Team WHERE team_long_name = 'Hannover 96') AND date LIKE '2015-09-10%' LIMIT 10000
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE NOT weight IS NULL ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name FROM Team AS t INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow' LIMIT 10000
SELECT DISTINCT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team AS t JOIN Team_Attributes AS ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge' LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS games_played FROM Match WHERE season = '2015/2016' AND league_id = (SELECT id FROM League WHERE name = 'Serie A') LIMIT 10000

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date FROM client AS c INNER JOIN disp AS d ON c.client_id = d.client_id INNER JOIN card AS ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id INNER JOIN loan AS l ON d.account_id = l.account_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND ca.type = 'credit card' LIMIT 10000

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp AS dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor' AND dp.type = 'OWNER' LIMIT 10000
SELECT c.client_id FROM client AS c JOIN disp AS d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN loan AS l ON d.account_id = l.account_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' ORDER BY l.amount DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT d.nationality FROM drivers AS d JOIN qualifying AS q ON d.driverId = q.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 355 AND q.q2 = '0:01:40' LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.year) FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.name = 'Silverstone Circuit' AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix' LIMIT 10000
SELECT DISTINCT c.name, c.location, r.name FROM circuits AS c JOIN races AS r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE c.country = 'USA' AND r.year = 2006 LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.country = 'Italy' LIMIT 10000
SELECT DISTINCT c.url FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.year = 2009 AND r.name LIKE '%Spanish%' LIMIT 10000

SELECT d.driverRef FROM drivers AS d JOIN results AS r ON d.driverId = r.driverId JOIN races AS ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND ra.year = 2007 AND r.positionOrder = 1 LIMIT 10000
SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM constructors AS c JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId WHERE cr.raceId = 291 AND cr.points = 0 LIMIT 10000
SELECT driverRef FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'German' ORDER BY dob ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS shortest_lap_ms FROM lapTimes AS lt JOIN drivers AS d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId GROUP BY lt.driverId ORDER BY shortest_lap_ms ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT DISTINCT e.event_name FROM event AS e JOIN attendance AS a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event JOIN member AS m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE m.first_name = 'Maya' AND m.last_name = 'Mclean' LIMIT 10000

SELECT SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost FROM expense AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id JOIN event AS ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id WHERE e.expense_description LIKE '%Poster%' AND ev.event_date = '2019-09-04' LIMIT 10000
SELECT e.event_name FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event ORDER BY b.amount DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name FROM member AS m JOIN budget AS b ON m.member_id IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget = b.budget_id) JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' LIMIT 10000
SELECT SUM(cost) AS total_expense FROM expense WHERE expense_date = '2019-08-20' LIMIT 10000
SELECT DISTINCT e.expense_description FROM expense AS e JOIN member AS m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha' AND m.last_name = 'Harrison' LIMIT 10000
SELECT DISTINCT e.event_name, e.location FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.remaining > 0 LIMIT 10000

WITH member_event_expenses AS (SELECT e.link_to_member, COUNT(DISTINCT b.link_to_event) AS event_count, SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost FROM expense AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY e.link_to_member HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.link_to_event) > 1) SELECT m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name, mee.total_cost FROM member_event_expenses AS mee JOIN member AS m ON mee.link_to_member = m.member_id ORDER BY mee.total_cost DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT z.city FROM member AS m LEFT JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE m.first_name = 'Garrett' AND m.last_name = 'Gerke' LIMIT 10000
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.position FROM member AS m JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code WHERE z.city = 'Lincolnton' AND z.state = 'North Carolina' AND z.zip_code = 28092 LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM hero_power WHERE power_id IN (SELECT id FROM superpower WHERE power_name = 'Super Strength')) AND height_cm > 200 LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero AS s JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE c.colour = 'Gold' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 10000
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE id = (SELECT hero_id FROM hero_power GROUP BY hero_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 10000

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM superhero AS s JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180 LIMIT 10000
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE alignment_id = (SELECT id FROM alignment WHERE alignment = 'Neutral') LIMIT 10000

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name FROM superhero AS sh LEFT JOIN alignment AS a ON sh.alignment_id = a.id LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON sh.id = hp.hero_id LEFT JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE sh.superhero_name = 'Atom IV' LIMIT 10000
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = (SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'DC Comics') ORDER BY weight_kg DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND (l.TP < 6.0 OR l.TP > 8.5) THEN p.ID END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) * 100 AS percentage FROM Patient AS p LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'F' LIMIT 10000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient AS p LEFT JOIN Examination AS e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE e.ID IS NULL OR (CAST(SUBSTRING(e."Examination Date", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTRING(p."First Date", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= 1) LIMIT 10000
SELECT e.Symptoms FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE p.Birthday = '1959-03-01' AND e."Examination Date" = '1993-09-27' LIMIT 10000
SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+' ORDER BY ID LIMIT 10000

SELECT AVG(CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', p.Birthday) AS REAL)) AS average_age FROM Patient AS p INNER JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l."T-CHO" >= 250 LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination AS e JOIN Laboratory AS l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE l.APTT > 45 AND e.Thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (l.FG < 150 OR l.FG > 450) LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination AS e INNER JOIN Laboratory AS l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0 AND e."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%' LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination AS e INNER JOIN Laboratory AS l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE l."T-CHO" < 250 AND e."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 10000
SELECT AVG(l.PT) FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l.PT < 14 LIMIT 10000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) FROM atom AS a JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id JOIN bond AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE (a.element = 'i' OR a.element = 's') AND b.bond_type = '-' LIMIT 10000
SELECT DISTINCT a2.atom_id FROM atom AS a1 JOIN connected AS c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE a1.molecule_id = 'TR181' LIMIT 10000

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count FROM molecule AS m JOIN bond AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '=' GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT element) FROM atom WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' UNION SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_8') AND element IN ('cl', 'c')) = 2 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS result LIMIT 10000
SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2 FROM connected AS c JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#' LIMIT 10000
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR008' AND element = 'c' LIMIT 10000
